proposals.evidence: DEDR 5535 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam vēr, Kannada/Tulu bēr(u), Telugu vēru, Parji vār and Konda vēla ‘root’. The survey root senses and rhotic/lateral stems fit these comparanda; source forms are preserved without imposing one language's spelling on another. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
